short: Enhance-then-AV-recognise (M06) is standard: video used twice predates it (2002, 2013); LRS3 0 dB WER 41.1% to 25.5%, but one run, a clean-trained AV baseline and copied baselines.
position: AE-MSR [@xu2020discriminative] changes processing (M06): a lip-guided mask enhancer before an audio-visual EleAtt-GRU recogniser, and a pseudo-3D (P3D) front-end; both standard. Using the video to enhance and then to recognise was done with HMMs in 2002 and 2013 [@deligne2002avcdcn; @abdelaziz2013twin]. The authors credit the enhancer's 1D ResNet block to My Lips Are Concealed [@afouras2019concealed] and claim the TCN upgrade (§1, §3.1). At 0 dB the second visual pass takes VA 32.5% to VAV 25.5% WER (Table 3), but each system runs once and seven baseline cells equal published values [@afouras2018deep] from other data and babble (inference). The LRW result clears the closest boundary-free prior, 84.33% [@stafylakis2018pushing], only if no word boundaries were used, which is unstated; [concurrent] work reports 85.3% [@martinez2020tcn].
